During "winter" the mosquitoes suddenly stop being a problem and you don't start sweating as soon as you go outside so it's my favorite season here. Upstate New York here. Winter is cold, to the point where anything in the low to mid 40s Fahrenheit feels like summer. Around me people have a weird relationship with snow. At the beginning of the winter people like it, and you can probably thank Christmas songs/movies for that. Kids have fun in it and always hoping for a snow day. But come late January, early February people get sick of it. That's when people start to remember it's a pain to drive in the snow, you gotta get up early and shovel out the driveway so you can get to work, hopefully the city/town has come through and plowed the road so you can get down the street etc. Not to mention, once it starts to melt and turn to slush everything gets dirty.

But on the other side, people who are into winter sports love the snow. Personally I think riding snowmobiles is pretty fun but that's the end of it. I know a couple people who are avid skiers and snowboarders and they absolutely love the winter and think it ends too soon.
